Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1317
Claimant:
Michael Gilbert
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
2023-04-23
First notice of loss received from the policyholder's household member, who was driving at the time of a low-speed
head-on collision. The driver is covered as a household member under the policy, and the claimant has retained a
lawyer who has asked that all contact go through their office.
2023-06-22
Vehicle inspection completed. The damage matches the described impact, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is
known. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
2023-07-29
Police report and people at the scene confirm the claimant was in the vehicle. Photos from the scene confirm some
details of the collision, but no independent witness saw the impact itself.
2023-10-17
Claimant's medical records show neck and back strain, which is a plausible injury for a crash of this type. Records
also show no earlier injury to the same body area.
2023-11-01
Recorded statement taken from the claimant. The account differs from the first notice in the direction of impact and in
the number of people in the car, and this has been noted for follow-up with counsel.
2023-11-30
Treatment has continued to grow well beyond what this injury usually requires, with more visits and new services
added each month. Medical review requested to assess whether the scope of care matches the injury, and the claim
remains open pending that review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
